description: NaDyCl₄ is Baddeleyite-derived structured and crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven Cl¹⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.73-3.23 Å. Dy³⁺ is bonded to seven Cl¹⁻ atoms to form distorted edge-sharing DyCl₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Dy-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.57-2.79 Å. There are four inequivalent Cl¹⁻ sites. In the first Cl¹⁻ site, Cl¹⁻ is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and one Dy³⁺ atom. In the second Cl¹⁻ site, Cl¹⁻ is bonded to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Dy³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ClNa₂Dy₂ trigonal pyramids. In the third Cl¹⁻ site, Cl¹⁻ is bonded to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Dy³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNa₂Dy₂ tetrahedra. In the fourth Cl¹⁻ site, Cl¹⁻ is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Dy³⁺ atoms.
